title: IRC: expose DIDs as meshIRCd does, by WHOIS 320 and METADATA GET
description:
Mark, 2026-11-22: expose DIDs the same way meshIRCd does. Consuming its did:key identities is the separate question on mimid-5ltz.

WORK, matching meshIRCd's shapes so one convention covers both servers:
- WHOIS numeric 320, which needs no client support at all: 'DID <uri>' for a user whose Person record has a did:webvh DID, and a line saying plainly when they have none, since then their provider's word is all there is (the BasicCredential weakness of mimid-1wgh.4.81). A 'Verified' line is honest for mimid: a did:webvh DID on a leaf was verified as a condition of membership.
- 'METADATA <nick|*> GET identity', answered as ':<server> METADATA <nick> identity * :<value>'. An unsupported key is 'FAIL METADATA KEY_NOT_SUPPORTED', an unknown nick ERR_NOSUCHNICK.
- 'METADATA * SET identity' and CLEAR are REFUSED with 'FAIL METADATA CANNOT_SET': in mimid the DID comes from the MLS credential, not from the client (see mimid-5ltz).
- The existing 'identity <user>' service command becomes the long form of the same facts.

OPEN, to settle while building: meshIRCd's METADATA value is the full JSON-LD DID document the client set. mimid has only the DID URI, because the document lives in the did:webvh log the agent verified and does not republish. Emitting a minimal '{"id":"<did>"}' keeps the shape a meshIRCd-shaped consumer expects while saying only what mimid knows; that is an INVENTED choice and must be labelled as one in the code.
close_reason: Landed with WHOIS 320 in meshIRCd's shape, METADATA GET identity, and SET/CLEAR refused. Consuming did:key stays open on mimid-5ltz.
